candidate_workaround: Run the authoritative child separately and propagate its exit status before subsequent commands.
failure_signature: A compound PowerShell validation wrapper returns a later command's success after an earlier child failed.
recurrence_guard: Check every authoritative child exit status immediately or use separate fail-fast invocations.
rollback: Retain the misleading aggregate exit as a failure and grant no pass credit to the wrapper.
scope_boundary: PowerShell validation-wrapper behavior only; not canonical final validation or independent reproduction.
title: Propagate authoritative child failures before later checks
trigger_preconditions: A PowerShell wrapper runs more than one authoritative validation child.
